summary: P3 Feature Testing: Design Templates and AI Image Gallery - All tests PASSED. Backend: 11/11 tests passed (design templates API returns 6 templates with correct structure, gallery CRUD all working, gallery_image in apply-media-changes uses provided URL directly). Frontend: Design template picker shows 6 templates with gradient previews, Gallery modal opens when 'Da Galeria' clicked, Gallery displays images with search.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P3 features (Design Templates and AI Image Gallery) are fully implemented and tested. Design templates endpoint returns 6 templates: corporativo, educacional, minimalista, tech, criativo, elegante. Gallery CRUD works correctly with company-based filtering. The gallery_image media type in apply-media-changes uses the galleryImageUrl directly without generating new images. Frontend design template picker at ConfigPanel step 2 shows 6 templates with gradient previews. Gallery modal opens from MediaConfigPanel when 'Da Galeria' is clicked.

GET /api/agent/design-templates.details: Returns 6 design templates with id, name, description, preview (gradient), palette (primary/accent/contentBg/text), fonts (heading/body), headerStyle, cornerRadius

GET /api/gallery/images.details: Returns images list filtered by company for regular users, all images for super_admin

POST /api/gallery/images.details: Saves image with imageUrl, keywords, projectId, projectName, userId, companyId

DELETE /api/gallery/images/{id}.details: Deletes image (only owner or super_admin can delete)

gallery_image in apply-media-changes.details: Uses galleryImageUrl directly without generating new image, creates image element at correct position

designTemplateId in session config.details: designTemplateId saved in session config and passed to generate_course_from_storyboard

Design template picker in ConfigPanel.details: Shows 6 templates in grid with gradient preview squares, selection shows checkmark and confirmation message

Gallery modal from Da Galeria click.details: Opens modal with title 'Galeria de Imagens', search input, image grid, click to select

Gallery modal search.details: Search input filters by keywords and project name

Selected gallery image preview.details: Shows thumbnail with keywords and 'Trocar imagem' link in slide card
